name: Ring of the Fortunate Fool
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of evasion and functions as such. The ring causes 1d3 points of temporary Wisdom damage each time the wearer successfully makes a Reflex saving throw for half damage.

Casting remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of evasion

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
